name: R Environment for replr
postCreateCommand:
Rscript -e 'cat("Checking required packages:
"); sapply(c("mirai", "nanonext", "processx", "evaluate", "R6", "uuid"), function(x) { if(requireNamespace(x, quietly=TRUE)) cat(x, ":", as.character(packageVersion(x)), "
") else cat(x, ": NOT FOUND
") })'
